creatures.haven-town.havC08.description:
{green|Coral Mermaid}

{gold|Special Ability : Water Warrior. Whirlpool Protector. Can cast Fortune. Can cast Seduce spell ater attack. Always have +1 luck.}

On water terrain Coral Mermaids attack, defence and speed are increased by 1.

When a hero enters the whirlpool, he loses 50% rounded up (i.e. is left with 50% rounded down) of the creatures in his army's weakest stack. The weakness is determined by the total Fight Value of the stacks. With Coral Mermaids in army, a hero can enter whirlpools without losing creatures.

Coral mermaids have 20% chance to cast Seduce spell after attack. This spell allows hero to control enemy troop until it will be attacked or after two turns (hypnotize effect). Undead, non-living and creatures with mind immunity are unaffected of this ability.

Additionally coral mermaids can cast two times per battle Fortune spell at advanced level (spell duration - 6 rounds).

The positive luck ability of coral mermaids can be affected by Hourglass of the Evil Hour or Cursed Ground magical terrain only. Their luck cannot be decreased below +1 by any other luck modifier. Coral mermaids are unable to get luck unless being commanded by a hero, like all the other neutral creatures, despite the game saying that they have +1 luck.

hero.haven-town.havAhero01.biography: Ethan claimed he is a master of archery. He used to join the union of pirates in Regna, and devoted himself for this union.
hero.haven-town.havAhero01.name: Ethan
hero.haven-town.havAhero01.specialty.des: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Archery skill.
hero.haven-town.havAhero02.biography: Irene was born in an island in Regna and she joined the pirates at a very young age. She battled for establishing the great union of pirates, but she supposes her life in Regnan Union is not ideal. Maybe this union is not suitable for a pirate who yearns for real freedom.
hero.haven-town.havAhero02.name: Irene
hero.haven-town.havAhero02.specialty.des: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Scouting skill.
hero.haven-town.havAhero03.biography: Maxon found giant turtles in a cove far from Regna islands. Now he tamed some of them and bring them back to his hometown. His experience impressed all of his friends.
hero.haven-town.havAhero03.name: Maxon
hero.haven-town.havAhero03.specialty.des: Increases Speed of any Gaint Turtle or Dragon Turtle by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 6 levels (rounded up)
hero.haven-town.havAhero04.biography: Captain Swift used to be an admiral from Erathia Navy. His ability of high speed frightened each opponent who dared to resist his army. No one knows why he betrayed Erathia royal household, and he still has a loyal troop from previous army.
hero.haven-town.havAhero04.name: Captain Swift
hero.haven-town.havAhero05.biography: Hayden betrayed previous captain because he would like to possess his own ship. He also left the Regnan Union to start a new voyage of discovery.
hero.haven-town.havAhero05.name: Hayden
hero.haven-town.havAhero05.specialty.des: Increases kingdom's income by 350 gold per day.
hero.haven-town.havAhero05B.biography: Wesley is fond of recording his experience from sailing. His diary is very detailed with different climates, animals and customs. During thirty years, he finished his own encyclopedia of navigation.
hero.haven-town.havAhero05B.name: Wesley
hero.haven-town.havAhero05B.specialty.de: Receives a 5% per level bonus to movement points at sea.
hero.haven-town.havAhero06.biography: Nadim's ethnic group (Marid) is a branch of Efreet and he also lived in Kreegan from his young age. In comparison to his relatives who have red skin, they don't like environment of fire and finally they have adapted their lives in water.
hero.haven-town.havAhero06.name: Nadim
hero.haven-town.havAhero06.specialty.des: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Marid or Marid Sultan for each level attained after 5th level.
hero.haven-town.havAhero07.biography: Gemma used to be a subordinate from Captain Bidley, she considered to train females as pirates during the war for establishing Regnan Union. Now she has her own ship and a loyal troop which constituted by female pirates.
hero.haven-town.havAhero07.name: Gemma
hero.haven-town.havAhero07.specialty.des: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Arbalists or Elite Arbalists for each level attained after 3rd level.
hero.haven-town.havAhero08.biography: 'Sniff' seems like a mocking nickname, but he's really proud of his sense of smell. That's also the reason why foes who try to track him often find themselves waylaid instead.
hero.haven-town.havAhero08.name: Sniff
hero.haven-town.havAhero08.specialty.des: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Wererat or Wererat Rager for each level attained after 1st level.
hero.haven-town.havMhero09.biography: Candice's lover was a human and she used to enter the human society for living with him. However she cannot adapt the life far away from water. Finally she divorced with her lover and return to the sea. Sometimes she will also swim back to the port and looking at the village where used to live. She eventually knows becoming a human is only a dream.
hero.haven-town.havMhero09.name: Candice
hero.haven-town.havMhero09.specialty.des: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Mermaid or Coral Mermaid for each level attained after 4th level.
hero.haven-town.havMhero10.biography: Marcus claims he is an oceanographer. He always sit on the beach and looking at sea for a whole day. His theory of sea creature is demonstrated as useless, but he never stop his thought for oceanology.
hero.haven-town.havMhero10.name: Marcus
hero.haven-town.havMhero10.specialty.des: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Intelligence skill percentage.
hero.haven-town.havMhero11.biography: Raymond has an unconventional attitude of life. Compared with being a pirate, he like to find some different sea creatures. Some one said he is the first one who found the Sea Serpent in a stormy cove.
hero.haven-town.havMhero11.name: Raymond
hero.haven-town.havMhero11.specialty.des: Casts Lightning Bolt with increased effect, based on hero level compared to the level of the target unit (the bonus is greater when used on weaker units).
hero.haven-town.havMhero12.biography: Beth lost her family at a very young age, and she became the youngest crew mate from pirates. No one will underestimate her as a girl, because she is more dangerous than male pirates.
hero.haven-town.havMhero12.name: Beth
hero.haven-town.havMhero12.specialty.des: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Offense skill percentage.
hero.haven-town.havMhero13.biography: Leander used to learn magic for decades of years, but he has a dream to become navigator at senior age. Now he started his voyage from a small harbour, it is still not late for chasing a dream.
hero.haven-town.havMhero13.name: Leander
hero.haven-town.havMhero13.specialty.des: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Sorcery skill percentage.
hero.haven-town.havMhero14.biography: Maram learned much from pirates, she was not skilled as navigation, but people often see some marine monsters in her ship. Maybe her voyage was helped by these creatures.
hero.haven-town.havMhero14.name: Maram
hero.haven-town.havMhero14.specialty.des: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Diver or Deep one for each level attained after 2nd level.
hero.haven-town.havMhero15.biography: Amber is similar with his father Andal from almost all aspects. She knew his father as a 'famous' smuggler who can always collect crystal and gems. The girl is good at business as well as his father. Nowadays she left his father because he chose to become a servant of King Bidley. She disagreed with his decision and finally decided to start a new life, with herself.
hero.haven-town.havMhero15.name: Amber
hero.haven-town.havMhero15.specialty.des: Increases kingdom's gems production by 1 per day.
hero.haven-town.havMhero16.biography: Mermaid Haniyyah is popular from harbor residents. She often brings corals and pearls from the sea to exchange some stuffs from local people. She is also skilled at healing, which made her become more popular.
hero.haven-town.havMhero16.name: Haniyyah
hero.haven-town.havMhero16.specialty.des: Casts Cure with increased effect, based on hero level compared to the level of the target unit (the bonus is greater when used on weaker units).
